records.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production WIDESCREEN game environment extension, 16:9 landscape 2560x1440. Image1 is the approved Black Forest watercolor environment/style reference. Recompose into a continuous broad moonlit forest world extending far to both sides of a portrait combat stage placed later at the center. No UI in this image. On far LEFT: enormous ancient tree, curling roots, ivy, a hanging warm amber lantern, subtle moths, low mossy stones with natural space for a separate traveler cutout to stand in front. On RIGHT: deep forest glade, ruined arch silhouettes and dark foliage, quiet moonlit mist leaving room for a separate creature or card illustration. Across CENTER: a receding narrow stone path, distant gothic castle and pale moon in grey-blue mist. Deep indigo #12101a, antique gold #b08d3f accents, muted moss and burgundy leaves, exceptionally rich ink-and-watercolor old storybook detail, layered depth. Side areas should be beautiful environmental art that players can enjoy, not dark blank filler. Calm lighting supports overlay text at extreme top/bottom; no large bright focal light behind side text. Preserve the reference materials and restrained palette. NO characters, interface, panels, frames, parchment boxes, labels, letters, numbers, dashboard, text or watermark. Full-bleed scenery.
